title: After the Japanese Derby: The Precision Crown

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: From here on—!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaah—!!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh!?
Flash-senpai,
to think you had this much strength
left...!
—However!!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I will not surrender the crown!
DAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A ferocious clash among champions!
She has gloriously triumphed in the greatest
Derby in history!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash—!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I let it slip away...
The Japanese Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Khhh, dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Flash-senpai...!
That was a magnificent victory!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! Why?!
I had her marked the entire time~...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
What an immense cheer—!
Today's blessing belongs to you!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I gave it everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Papa, Mama...
I have no regrets about this day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding off illustrious Umamusume to stand
triumphant atop her generation was Eishin
Flash.
News of her spectacular feat swept through
the public in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Racing-Fan Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
To think she would show us a run of such
caliber!
It has burned itself into my memory.

text_block_list.name: Racing-Fan Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
She used to blend into the background of
her generation,
but now I can hardly wait for her next
race!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Flash-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Admittedly,
Flash-san ran that day in particular as
though she had received a massive buff.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes. During the race,
there was even a moment when I was
instinctively overwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
She throws herself into races with such
incredible passion.
I'm truly looking forward to competing with
her again.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my,
talking about Flash-san on this show too?
Ahaha, that makes me so happy~♪

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon-senpai—if I recall correctly,
you share a room with Flash-senpai,
do you not?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Flash-san worked insanely hard for the Nihon
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Heading out for runs at the crack of dawn,
staying out right up to curfew at night...
She managed a schedule like that with flawless
precision, day in and day out.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco would totally throw in the towel after
three days~...
Wait, huh?! Speak of the devil!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has assembled, I see.
...? Is there something on my face?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
We were just talking about the Japanese
Derby.
Flash-san was so amazing!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh my—
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Flash-senpai.
Regarding the Japanese Derby,
you carried special sentiments—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaah—!!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—No, I sensed something far beyond that from
you. Most certainly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...
It was a race dedicated to my father and
mother in Germany.
The way my parents live is both my dream
and my guiding star.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I intended to offer proof of my growth
by claiming victory at the Tokyo Yushun.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Both my father and mother praised me for
my victory at the Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It was only possible because all of you were
by my side.
—I thank you, from the depths of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san's running... that fierce heat.
It remains etched within my heart even
now.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It makes me almost regret our decision not
to contend in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Like Pisa,
I will not be running in the Kikuka Sho.
However,
we will have our rematch somewhere down the
line.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Consider yourself marked on my board
as a high-priority player.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Once again...
that was a truly magnificent race,
Flash-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(To be candid—I had never truly perceived
Flash-senpai as a formidable wall before.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Unnoticed by anyone, steadily preparing,
only to magnificently realize that grand
ambition on the grand stage.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...—Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her voice was calm,
yet carried a subtle undercurrent of
passion
that made me unconsciously pause my work.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I have borne the hopes of our clan,
sprinting forward for the sake of our
kingdom's founding and prosperity.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series is a world where only
the strong gather.
I knew well it would not be simple.
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To be surrounded by such captivating
rivals...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
In particular—at the Satsuki Sho,
just as promised,
Pisa brought about a magnificent circle
among the stands.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Flash-senpai,
who made an indelible mark on the Japanese
Derby with her latent strength.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
Looking back now, before I realized it—
I must have harbored arrogance within
myself.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
She is a descendant who shoulders the
clan.
Thus,
she believes she was blessed with the talent
to found a kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And yet, in this arena,
I am by no means the sole power.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Their strength taught me that lesson.
This realization will surely nourish my
growth henceforth.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And that is precisely why I feel it.
—I want to surpass them.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I wish to stand as the representative of
this golden generation.
Only then, surely,
can I establish the prestige my house so
desperately requires.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gust of wind swept past.
Her eyes sparkled as if in response.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Our next race is the final leg of the
Classic Triple Crown—
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she said,
our next battle is the final leg of the
Classic
Triple Crown: the 3,000-meter turf race,
the Kikuka Sho. A grueling
contest demanding stamina over a punishing
course and long distance.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“'The strongest horse girl wins'—
is that not an exquisitely fitting maxim?”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Neither Pisa nor Ruler are here.
Yet demonstrating one's true prowess does
not necessarily require the presence of
rivals on the track.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us claim a victory so dazzling
that even their phantom 'what-ifs' will not
cross anyone's mind.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Upon the finale of the Classic Triple Crown
road,
I shall adorn it with a crimson rose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer passes in the blink of an eye.
I must accomplish what needs to be done
toward the Kikuka Sho.
